text:
Ravi (AE): FYI procurement at Orion Health paused signing until we resolve a few things: EU invoicing to their NL entity, SCCs for data transfer, and a request to countersign via their in-house e-sign tool (not DocuSign). cc @Laila @Tom

Priya (SE): Do they require on-prem or Hosted? That will affect our SCC exposure.

Ravi (AE): They want Dedicated for PHI workloads in EU. Procurement says SCCs + DPA changes mandatory. Also asked for an addendum for customer-managed logs retention (7 years).

Laila (Legal): Okay. SCCs are standard but need to ensure flow works with Dedicated + Private control plane. I'll prepare a DPA with SCC attachment and a short addendum for logs retention. The 7 year retention is unusual; we should check with Security on retention policy.

Tom (Finance): On the EU invoicing: we can invoice their NL entity but need VAT ID and billing address. If they want separate invoices per entity (US R&D + NL ops), we need to split the order form lines and confirm currency (EUR vs USD).

Ravi (AE): They specifically wrote: "We will provide two POs — one for the US contract, one for NL entity. Invoice NL in EUR, US in USD."

Priya (SE): Tech ask from infra: they want TLS client cert mutual auth for service-to-service egress. Is that supported for Dedicated?

Laila (Legal): Mutual TLS is an ops detail but we can add a security spec reference in the order form. For the DPA redlines: they want a clause limiting processor sub-processors without prior written consent. That's too restrictive; propose a modeled response: notice + objection window.

Ravi (AE): Also procurement flagged signature flow: they only accept signed agreements via their internal tool (NotarizeMe). We usually use DocuSign. Can we accept their e-sign?

esig-bot: Integrations: DocuSign (yes), HelloSign (yes), custom SSO e-sign tool (needs legal review). See: https://internal.redwood/esign-integration-guide

Tom (Finance): For accounting we can accept their NotarizeMe signed PDF as long as there's a clear signer audit trail and the signatory is authorized. Will need a countersign by our CFO or delegated signer.

Laila (Legal): I'll run a quick review of sample NotarizeMe audit log. If acceptable will add a countersign delegation clause allowing Director-level countersign for orders <= $100k. For larger deals CFO must countersign.

Priya (SE): On the SCCs, security asked to confirm data flow diagrams before attaching. I'll ping Security to drop diagrams and the Dedicated network topology.

Ravi (AE): Pricing: they've agreed MRR equivalent to $3,750/month (annual commit). They want a one-time setup credit if onboarding extends past 30 days.

Tom (Finance): We can include a one-time setup credit clause: onboarding extended >30 days = $5k credit on first invoice. Need Legal to sign off. Also currency conversion note in order form.

Laila (Legal): Drafting plan: (1) DPA + SCC annex, (2) Order form with split-entity billing lines, (3) e-sign acceptance clause and countersign delegation, (4) log retention addendum. ETA EOD GMT.

esig-bot: Reminder: when accepting external e-sign tools attach: (a) sample audit log, (b) signer authority proof, (c) retention policy.

Ravi (AE): Action items:
- Laila: deliver redline + clean DPA/SCC annex + order form with split lines + countersign clause by EOD
- Priya: produce network/dataflow diagram + confirm mTLS support
- Tom: prepare billing template for dual-entity invoicing and EUR line item formatting

Tom (Finance): I'll also confirm whether AR can accept EUR invoice net30 and USD invoice net30 separately and how to map to our revenue recognition.

Priya (SE): Quick tech note for the order form: include field "Deployment target: eu-west-1 (Dedicated)" and "Model pinning: allowed for 90 days" so they have that captured.

Laila (Legal): Noted on model pinning. I'll add a short clause: "Customer may request model version pin for up to 90 days; Redwood will support where compatible with performance and security constraints."

Ravi (AE): Thanks all. I'll ask Procurement for the NotarizeMe sample audit log and the two POs once they confirm billing entities.

esig-bot: Checklist posted to thread: https://internal.redwood/accepting-external-esigners

Ravi (AE): Closing loop: will update thread when I have their sample log and VAT details. :v:
